name: Gl1_CpmPhys
description:
Render CpmPhys objects of interactions.

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_CpmPhys.contactLine(=true)

	Show contact line

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_CpmPhys.dmgLabel(=true)

	Numerically show contact damage parameter

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_CpmPhys.dmgPlane(=false)

	[what is this?]

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_CpmPhys.epsT(=false)

	Show shear strain 

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_CpmPhys.epsTAxes(=false)

	Show axes of shear plane 

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_CpmPhys.normal(=false)

	Show contact normal

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_CpmPhys.colorStrainRatio(=-1)

	If positive, set the interaction (wire) color based on $\eps_N$ normalized by $\eps_0$ x colorStrainRatio<CpmPhys.colorStrainRatio> ($\eps_0$ = CpmPhys.epsCrackOnset ). Otherwise, color based on the residual strength.

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_CpmPhys.epsNLabel(=false)

	Numerically show normal strain

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be a valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.
